text.tspan: "It can't connect": check the path in this order, every time
Evidence that proves which layer is broken
VPC Flow Logs: REJECT = SG/NACL blocked it · ACCEPT but no reply = OS/app problem · no record = routing/DNS
Reachability Analyzer: tests the path between two resources without sending traffic
ELB target health reason · CloudTrail: who changed the SG/route/NACL and when · CloudWatch metrics/logs
